snap.gml: var r = global.run; global.snap = { node: r.node, fuel: r.fuel, scrap: r.scrap, sector: r.sector, moves: r.moves, deadline: r.deadline, facs: array_length(r.car.facs) }; return true;

layout_mode.gml: var c = global.garage_ctx; return (c.shop == false && c.from_map == true && array_length(c.stock) == 0);

nothing_spent.gml: var r = global.run; var s = global.snap; return (r.node == s.node && r.fuel == s.fuel && r.scrap == s.scrap && r.sector == s.sector && r.moves == s.moves && r.deadline == s.deadline);

rearrange.gml: var c = global.run.car; if (array_length(c.facs) == 0) return -1; var did = c.facs[0].def; var ox = c.facs[0].ox; var oy = c.facs[0].oy; car_remove(c, 0); var spot = car_find_space(c, fac(did).cells); if (!is_array(spot)) return -2; car_place(c, did, spot[0], spot[1], 0); global.moved = (spot[0] != ox || spot[1] != oy); return array_length(c.facs);

shop_visit_still_stocks.gml: garage_open(true); var c = global.garage_ctx; return (c.shop == true && c.from_map == false && array_length(c.stock) == 5);
